title: 第20章 卖女抵债第21章 青龙帮死性不改的赌鬼
slug: 我武举人晚年才来武学修改器
content_zh:
陆云端坐车内，他自然也认出了那个在地上挣扎呼喊的罗津，他那早逝发妻罗青禾的亲侄子。
罗家当年在云港市虽非大富大贵，但也算是体面殷实的小康之家。
可惜好景不长，罗青禾的父亲罗正盛放手养老后，家业由独子罗乔宇接手，也就是陆云的小舅子。
罗乔宇能力平平，守成尚可，进取不足，家道渐渐显出颓势。
更要命的是，他身体也不太好，在罗津十几岁时就撒手人寰，留下孤儿寡母和一份日渐缩水的家业。
罗津作为罗家长孙，自小被祖父罗正盛和母亲溺爱过度，养成了骄纵任性、吃不得苦的性子。
他父亲罗乔宇去世后，更是无人能管束得了他。
罗家的家底根本经不起他的挥霍，罗津很快就与一群狐朋狗友厮混在一起，还染上了抽大烟的恶习。
最后后又沉迷赌博，妄图一夜暴富挽回败局，结果却是越陷越深。
陆云念在亡妻的情分上，早年也曾接济过、甚至将他安排到陆家商行做过事，指望他能浪子回头。
但罗津恶习难改，屡教不听，甚至挪用商行款项去赌去抽。
最终，他被陆云盛怒之下赶了出去，并言明不再管他死活。
罗津此时如同抓住了最后一根救命稻草，拼命呼喊着“姑父”
他希冀那位曾经威严无比、富甲一方的姑父，能看在死去的亲姑姑面上，再救他这一次。
那群青龙帮的混混见颜临同气度不凡，开的是好车，称呼那烟鬼为“少爷”
，又听他喊“姑父”
，顿时有些迟疑。
为首几人互相使着眼色，暂时没敢上前，但也没离开，显然是想看看形势。
这时，颜临同脸色复杂，转头看向车内，这事涉及到师傅的家事，他可不敢擅自做主。
罗津见颜临同只是看向车内，并没有立刻回应，心中愈发焦急。

他强撑着站起身，踉跄着扑到轿车后排的车窗前。
隔着玻璃，罗津终于看清了车内端坐的那道威严身影。
正是他那多年未见的姑父，陆云！
对这位姑父，罗津只有一种深入骨髓的畏惧，和在面对高不可攀大人物的敬仰。
但此刻，什么畏惧敬仰都被求生的本能压了下去。
他知道自己早就将这位姑父的心伤透，光求饶卖惨恐怕没用。
就在这时，罗津像是想起了什么，立刻换上一副悲戚欲绝的表情。
“姑父！
姑父！
您终于来了！
快……快去看看我爷爷吧！”
“他老人家……他老人家快不行了，就想在临走前见您一面啊！”
紧接着，他指着身后那群青龙帮混混：“还有！
还有我女儿！
妍妍！
您的外曾孙女罗妍妍，被这群天杀的混蛋给捉走了！”
“他们说……他们说要把我女儿卖到南洋！
姑父，求求您救救妍妍，她现在才十二岁啊！”
那群青龙帮的混混听到罗津颠倒黑白、反咬一口，顿时就急眼了。
领头那个刀疤脸混混勃然大怒，指着罗津的鼻子骂道：“放你娘的狗屁！

罗津，你他妈少在那里血口喷人，胡说八道！”
content_en:
Lu Yunduan was sitting in the car, and he naturally recognized Luo Jin, who was struggling and shouting on the ground, his nephew from his wife Luo Qinghe who died young.
Although the Luo family was not a wealthy family in Yungang City back then, it could still be considered a respectable and well-off family.
Unfortunately, the good times did not last long. After Luo Qinghe's father, Luo Zhengsheng, took care of his old age, the family business was taken over by his only son, Luo Qiaoyu, who was Lu Yun's brother-in-law.
Luo Qiaoyu's ability is mediocre, he can maintain success, but he is not enterprising enough, and his family fortune is gradually showing decline.
What's more terrible is that he was not in good health. He passed away when Luo Jin was a teenager, leaving behind orphans, widows and a dwindling family fortune.
As the grandson of the Luo family, Luo Jin was overspoiled by his grandfather Luo Zhengsheng and his mother since he was a child, and he developed an arrogant and willful character who could not bear hardships.
After his father Luo Qiaoyu passed away, no one could control him.
The Luo family's financial resources could not withstand his squandering. Luo Jin soon got involved with a group of bad friends and got into the bad habit of smoking.
In the end, he became addicted to gambling, trying to get rich overnight to save the situation, but he ended up getting deeper and deeper into trouble.
Out of love for his late wife, Lu Yunnian had helped him out in his early years and even arranged for him to work in the Lu Family Trading Company, hoping that he would turn around as a prodigal son.
However, Luo Jin's bad habits are hard to change, and he refuses to listen despite repeated admonitions, and even misappropriates the company's funds to gamble and smoke.
In the end, he was driven out by Lu Yun in anger and made it clear that he no longer cared about his life or death.
Luo Jin seemed to have grasped the last straw at this time, desperately calling "Uncle"
He hoped that his uncle, who was once extremely majestic and wealthy, would save him again for the sake of his dead aunt.
The gangsters from the Qinglong Gang saw that Yan Lintong was very cool and drove a good car, so they called the smoker "Young Master"
, and heard him call "uncle"
, suddenly hesitated.
The leaders winked at each other and did not dare to step forward for the time being, but they did not leave either, obviously wanting to take a look at the situation.
At this time, Yan Lintong had a complex expression and turned to look inside the car. This matter involved the master's family affairs, and he did not dare to make the decision without authorization.
Luo Jin became increasingly anxious when he saw that Yan Lintong just looked into the car and did not respond immediately.
He forced himself to stand up and staggered to the rear window of the car.
Through the glass, Luo Jin finally saw clearly the majestic figure sitting in the car.
It was his uncle whom he had not seen for many years, Lu Yun!
For this uncle, Luo Jin only had a bone-deep fear and admiration for someone who was unattainable.
But at this moment, any fear or admiration was suppressed by the instinct of survival.
He knew that he had broken his uncle's heart a long time ago, and it would be useless to just beg for mercy and suffer hardship.
At this moment, Luo Jin seemed to remember something and immediately put on a sorrowful expression.
"Uncle!
Uncle!
You are finally here!
Hurry...go and see my grandpa! "
"His old man...his old man is dying, and he just wants to see you before he leaves!"
Then, he pointed at the group of Qinglong Gang gangsters behind him: "There's more!
And my daughter!
Yanyan!
Your great-granddaughter Luo Yanyan was captured by these damn bastards! "
"They said... they said they would sell my daughter to Nanyang!
Uncle, please save Yanyan, she is only twelve years old now! "
The gangsters from the Qinglong Gang became anxious when they heard that Luo Jin was confusing right and wrong and biting back.
The scar-faced gangster in the lead became furious, pointed at Luo Jin’s nose and cursed: “Fuck your mother’s bullshit!
Luo Jin, stop fucking talking about people and talking nonsense! "
